   function formatLastLoginDate(dateStr) {
        if(dateStr==null || dateStr=="") { return ""};
        var givenDate = new Date(dateStr);
        var yyyy = givenDate.getFullYear();
        var mm = givenDate.getMonth()+1;
        var dd = givenDate.getDate();
        if(dd<10){
            dd='0'+dd;
        }
        if(mm<10){
            mm='0'+mm;
        }
        var analyticsDate = mm+'/'+dd+'/'+yyyy;
        return analyticsDate;
    }

   function getCookie(cname) {
        var reg = new RegExp(cname + "=(.*?)(?:;|$)");
        var value = document.cookie.match(reg);

        return value ? value[1] : "";
   }

    function splitZip(zipCode) {
        var result = "";
        if (zipCode) {
            result = zipCode.split(new RegExp('[-+()*/:? ]', 'g'))[0];
        }
        return result;
    }


    function getLoginStatus() {
        var status = "";
        var user = getCookie("customerName");
        if (!user || user.length == 0) {
            status = "guest";
        } else {
            status = "signed in";
        }

        return status;
    }

    //Data Layer Object Created
    var digitalData = window.digitalData = (window.digitalData || {});
    digitalData.page = {
        pageInfo: {
            "pageID": "home",
            "destinationURL": window.location.href.split('?',1)[0],
            "referringURL": document.referrer,
            "pageType": "maytag/v2/components/pages/homepage",
            "pageMindset":"",
            "brand": "maytagv2",
            "attributes": {
                "errorPage": "false",
                "country": "us",
                "language": "en-us"
            }
        }

    };


   digitalData.user = {
        profile: {
            profileInfo: {
                "profileID": getCookie('profileID'),
                "profileEmail": getCookie('email'),
                "soldToGroupCode": getCookie('groupCode'),
                "soldToNumber": getCookie('soldTo'),
                "soldToGroup": getCookie('soldToGroup'),
                "productsOwned": "",
                "lastInteraction": formatLastLoginDate(getCookie('lastLogin'))
            },
            attributes: {
                "loginStatus": getLoginStatus()
            }
        }
    };

    digitalData.cart = window.digitalData.cart || {};
    if ("true" && localStorage.getItem("cartData") !== "undefined" && localStorage.getItem("cartData") !== null) {
        digitalData.cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("cartData"));
    }
    digitalData.version = 'DTC';
    digitalData.page.pageInfo.applicationSource = 'AEM';

   document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

       userLocation.getUserLocation(function (locationData) {
           if (locationData) {
               digitalData.user.activeLocationZip = splitZip(locationData.zipCode);
               digitalData.user.activeLocationLDC = locationData.ldcCode;
               digitalData.user.activeLocationRDC = locationData.rdcCode;
               digitalData.user.activeLocationLDCActive = locationData.isLdcActive;
               digitalData.user.activeLocationMajorsCommerce = locationData.majorsCommerceEnabled;
               digitalData.user.profile.address = {};
               digitalData.user.profile.address.city = locationData.city;
               digitalData.user.profile.address.state_province = locationData.state;
               digitalData.user.profile.address.postalcode = locationData.zipCode;
               digitalData.user.profile.address.country = locationData.country;
           }
       });
   });

</script>

<style data-di-rand="1571834602779" data-di-res-id="9e9dfd41-1a70ca60" data-di-track="1">
/* HOME STYLES */
    .button.secondary {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: #002E5F;
    border: none;
    }
    .button.secondary:hover, .button.secondary:focus {
    border: none;
    background-color: transparent;
    color: #001B38;
    }
    .baseComponent.section.columncontrol {
        padding: 50px 0 50px 0;
    }
    .highest-rated-container {
         margin: -50px -50vw 0 -50vw;
        padding: 0px 50vw 0px 50vw;
        background: #F4F4F4;
        overflow-x:hidden;
        position: relative;
        transition: margin .3s ease-out;
    }

    .highest-rated-container .rated-logo{
      margin-top: 20px;
    }
    .highest-rated-container h3 {color: #0F305B; font-size: 30px;}
    .highest-rated-container p {color: #000;}
    
    .owner-center-container h2 {
        font-size: 2.75rem;
    }
    .owner-center-first {margin-bottom: 50px;}
    .owner-center-last {margin-top: 50px;}
    
    .blue-banner-full-width {
        margin: 0 -50vw 0 -50vw;
        padding: 50px 50vw 0 50vw;
        background: #002E5F;
        overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    
    .blue-banner-full-width h2 {color: #ffffff; font-size: 4rem; line-height: 4rem;}
    .blue-banner-full-width p {color: #ffffff; font-size: 1.6rem;}
    .blue-banner-full-width a {color: #ffffff; font-size: 1.6rem;}
    .blue-banner-full-width .image {margin-bottom: 0px;}
    
    .dependability-container h2 {
        font-size: 5rem;
        line-height: 5rem;
    }
    .dependability-container p {
        font-size: 1.6rem;
        line-height: 1.6rem;
    }

    .baseComponent.richtext {
    padding: 0 10px 0 10px;
    }
    
    @media only screen and (max-width: 480px) {
        .baseComponent.section.columncontrol {
            padding: 0px 0 10px 0;
        }
        .highest-rated-container {
        margin: -50px -50vw 0 -50vw;
        padding: 25px 55vw 0 55vw;
        
        filter: progid:DXImageTransform.Microsoft.gradient( startColorstr='#000000', endColorstr='#012d5c',GradientType=0 ); /* IE6-9 */
        overflow-x:hidden;
        }
        .blue-banner-full-width {
        margin: 0 -50vw 0 -50vw;
        padding: 0 50vw 0 50vw;
        background-color: #002E5F;
        overflow-x:hidden;
        }
    }
  
    @media(max-width: 768px){
      .rated-copy h3{
        line-height: 1.1;
      }

      .rated-logo img{
        max-width: 200px;
        float: none;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }
    }

    @media(max-width: 600px){
      body .highest-rated-container > .row.column-presentation{
        display: block;
      }

      .rated-copy{
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .rated-logo{
        width: 100%;
      }

      .rated-logo img{
        float: none;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      .highest-rated-container{
        margin-top: 0;
      }
    }
    
/* HOME STYLES END */

.highest-rated-container > .row.column-presentation{
  display: flex;
}

.highest-rated-container .rated-copy, .highest-rated-container .rated-logo{
  display: flex;

  align-self: center;
}

  display: block;
  height: auto;
}

}

  .masthead__list li:last-of-type {
    border-right: none;
  }

  .masthead__list li:hover {
    cursor: pointer;
    background-color: #005ABB;
    color: #FFFFFF;
  }

  .masthead__list li:hover a {
    transform: translateY(-55%);
  }

  .masthead__list a:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .masthead a img {
    display: block;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .content-card.adjustable-height-comp {
    min-height: 225px;
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {

    .masthead {
      height: 90vh;
      max-height: 100vh;
    }
  }

  /*carousel-styles*/

  .home .carousel-headline {
    padding: 0;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .home .carousel-headline>div.richtext {
    padding: 70px 0 50px;
    background: #ffffff;
  }

  .home .carousel-headline>div.richtext h2 {
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .home .carousel-headline>div.richtext p {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  .home-page-carousel-container {
    background: #ffffff;
    padding-bottom: 80px;
  }

  .home-page-carousel.slick-dotted.slick-slider {
    position: relative;
    max-height: 650px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide {
    display: -webkit-box;
    display: -ms-flexbox;
    display: flex;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-box-direction: normal;
    -ms-flex-direction: column;
    flex-direction: column;
    -webkit-box-pack: center;
    -ms-flex-pack: center;
    justify-content: center;
    -webkit-box-align: center;
    -ms-flex-align: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center center;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    height: 650px;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide__content--fresh {
    background-image: url("https://www.maytag.com/content/dam/business-unit/maytag/en-us/marketing-content/site-assets/page-content/home-page/Images/optimization/home-carousel-wash.png");
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide__content--cold {
    background-image: url("https://www.maytag.com/content/dam/business-unit/maytag/en-us/marketing-content/site-assets/page-content/home-page/Images/optimization/home-carousel-cold.png");
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide__content--burners {
    background-image: url("https://www.maytag.com/content/dam/business-unit/maytag/en-us/marketing-content/site-assets/page-content/home-page/Images/optimization/home-carousel-convection.png");
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide__content--power {
    background-image: url("https://www.maytag.com/content/dam/business-unit/maytag/en-us/marketing-content/site-assets/page-content/home-page/Images/optimization/home-carousel-power.png");
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide__content {
    display: -webkit-box;
    display: -ms-flexbox;
    display: flex;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-box-direction: normal;
    -ms-flex-direction: column;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
    -webkit-box-pack: center;
    -ms-flex-pack: center;
    justify-content: center;
    -webkit-box-align: center;
    -ms-flex-align: center;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center center;
    max-height: 650px;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide h4 {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: "Helvetica";
    line-height: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 35px;
    text-transform: none;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide h4::after {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    margin-top: 10px;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: #005ABB;
    margin-left: -5px;
    margin-right: -5px;
    -webkit-clip-path: circle(0 at top);
    clip-path: circle(0 at top);
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide h4.visible::after {
    -webkit-clip-path: circle(100% at top);
    clip-path: circle(100% at top);
    transition: clip-path 1s ease, -webkit-clip-path 1s ease;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide h2 {
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 40px;
    line-height: 100%;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .home-page-slide p {
    color: #FFFFFF;
    margin: 30px 0;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 24px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .slick-dots {
    bottom: 80px;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .slick-dots li.slick-active button {
    background: none;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .slick-dots li button:before {
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1;
    height: 15px;
    width: 15px;
    color: transparent;
    opacity: 1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid #ffffff;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .slick-dots li.slick-active button:before {
    color: #005ABB;
    opacity: 1;
    background: #005ABB;
  }

  .home-page-carousel .slick-next {
    right: -40px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,%3csvg width='35' height='35' viewBox='0 0 35 35' version='1.1' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'%3e%3ctitle%3eCarousel Arrow%3c/title%3e%3cdesc%3eCreated using Figma%3c/desc%3e%3cg id='Canvas' transform='translate(-7267 -5957)'%3e%3cg id='Carousel Arrow'%3e%3cg id='Ellipse'%3e%3cuse xlink:href='%23path0_fill' transform='matrix(-1 1.22465e-16 -1.22465e-16 -1 7302 5992)' fill='%23005ABB'/%3e%3c/g%3e%3cg id='Vector'%3e%3cuse xlink:href='%23path1_stroke' transform='matrix(-1 1.22465e-16 -1.22465e-16 -1 7288.25 5979.75)' fill='%23FFFFFF'/%3e%3c/g%3e%3c/g%3e%3c/g%3e%3cdefs%3e%3cpath id='path0_fill' d='M 35 17.5C 35 27.165 27.165 35 17.5 35C 7.83502 35 0 27.165 0 17.5C 0 7.83502 7.83502 0 17.5 0C 27.165 0 35 7.83502 35 17.5Z'/%3e%3cpath id='path1_stroke' d='M 0 5.25L -0.353553 4.89645L -0.707107 5.25L -0.353553 5.60355L 0 5.25ZM 4.89645 -0.353553L -0.353553 4.89645L 0.353553 5.60355L 5.60355 0.353553L 4.89645 -0.353553ZM -0.353553 5.60355L 4.89645 10.8536L 5.60355 10.1464L 0.353553 4.89645L -0.353553 5.60355Z'/%3e%3c/defs%3e%3c/svg%3e ");

    content: none;
  }

  /*fixes flicker between last and first slide*/
  .slick-track,
  .slick-list {
    -webkit-perspective: 2000px;
    -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  }

  /*features-section-styles*/
  .feature-columns-container {
    margin-top: 0px;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column {
    max-height: 650px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column .content-column>div {
    width: 440px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-left: 0;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column .content-column h2,
  .feature-columns-container .feature-column .content-column p {
    color: #000000;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column .content-column>div.actionbutton .text-center {
    text-align: left;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column .content-column {
    height: 650px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column div.image {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column .image-column {
    padding: 0;
  }

  .feature-columns-container .feature-column .feature-left-image.image-column .img-wrapper {
    /*display: flex;*/
    max-height: 650px;
  }

<div>
<div class="seo-copy-block container"><h2>Trust Maytag<sup>®</sup> appliances to get the job done</h2>
<p>Maytag<sup>®</sup> kitchen appliances, <a data-di-id="di-id-b3832f65-10633935" href="/washers-and-dryers.html">washers and dryers</a> and other durable appliances and accessories are built to handle all your daily chores with ease. Our <a data-di-id="di-id-eca12a18-c0ba1bda" href="/fingerprint-resistant-stainless-steel.html">stainless steel appliances</a> give your kitchen a sleek and powerful look, while keeping your food cold, your dishes clean and your dinner hot. We’re proud to say we make dependable appliances you can rely on, and we’ll back that with a 10-year limited parts warranty,<sup>2</sup> so if something does go wrong, we’ll be there to fix it. Shop the full line of Maytag<sup>®</sup> products to find what you need today.</p>
</div>
